infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Label Lens AI requires camera access to scan packaged commodity labels, MRP, barcodes, and date stamps.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Label Lens AI requires microphone access to record voice compliance notes and official helpline calls.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Label Lens AI requires location access to geo-tag regulatory complaints and locate nearest enforcement offices.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Label Lens AI to scan packaged product labels, barcodes, and MRP declarations.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Label Lens AI to attach verified GPS coordinates to official complaints and calculate distances to nearest Legal Metrology offices.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Label Lens AI to record voice observations and helpline interactions with FSSAI/Legal Metrology authorities.
